name: ElevenLabs
profile:
## ElevenLabs for Hackathon Builders

**ElevenLabs** provides AI voice infrastructure for **text-to-speech, speech-to-text, voice cloning, voice agents, and generative audio**.

### Capabilities and APIs you can use in a weekend
- **ElevenAPI**: REST API plus official **Python** and **TypeScript** SDKs for embedding voice into apps.
- **Text-to-speech**: generate MP3 audio from text in a single request.
- **Speech-to-text**: transcribe audio, including **realtime streaming transcripts**.
- **Voice cloning**: clone a voice from an audio recording, or generate one from a text description.
- **Voice agents**: combine speech recognition, an LLM, text-to-speech, and turn-taking into a single agent.
- **Deployment options**: use a no-code browser app (**ElevenCreative**), a visual/programmatic agent platform (**ElevenAgents**), or a ready-made AI phone receptionist (**Reception.ai**).

### Hero use cases the docs showcase
- **Customer support**: agents that answer questions from your docs via a knowledge base.
- **Phone lines**: inbound/outbound calling through **Twilio** integration or SIP trunking.
- **Outbound campaigns**: make many calls at once with batch calling.
- **Web/app voice experiences**: embed voice and text agents in websites and apps via a widget.
- **Creative audio production**: voiceovers, music, dubs, and studio projects in the browser.

### What it rewards in hackathon projects
The docs don’t list hackathon prizes or formal judge criteria, but they strongly signal value in projects that demonstrate:
- **Real-time voice experiences**
- **Practical agent workflows** (support, calling, booking, operations)
- **Production readiness** such as low latency and scalability
- **Multilingual or expressive audio**
- **Voice cloning / personalized voices**
- **Clear use of their agent stack**: knowledge base, widget, Twilio/SIP, batch calling

### Recent or notable features worth building on now
- **Eleven v4 Turbo**: real-time speech synthesis with median latency around **100ms**.
- **Eleven Flash v2.5**: lower-cost TTS with similar fast latency and support for larger outputs.
- **Scribe v2 Realtime**: streaming transcription with about **150ms** median latency.
- **90+ language support** across key models.
- **Native Twilio integration** for phone agents.
- **Widget** for adding voice + text agents to websites/apps.
- **CLI onboarding**: the docs note you can get set up via `npx -y @elevenlabs/cli@latest onboard init`.

prior_art.title: RoadMate
prior_art.excerpt: ## Inspiration Every year, drowsy driving causes over 100,000 crashes globally, claiming 10,000-30,000 lives - a silent epidemic that strikes without warning. In the age of long commutes and late-night drives, we're all vulnerable to those dangerous moments when our eyes get heavy and our focus drifts. Despite modern vehicles having dozens of sensors and safety features, they can't meaningfully engage with the driver or understand the subtle signs of fatigue that precede an accident. Our inspiration came from a personal experience: A friend of ours dozed off and totaled his car a couple of weeks ago, fortunately he was unscathed. We realized that existing solutions - like basic alarm systems or periodic alerts - are not enough to address the core problem.
